user.title: Proton Link account
user.description: Sign in with the same phone number and password you use in the Proton Link app. The integration is read-only: it can read vehicle status but cannot start, lock or command the car.

data_description.mobile_phone: Malaysian mobile number, e.g. 60123456789. A leading + or 0 is accepted and converted.

error.invalid_phone: That does not look like a valid Malaysian mobile number.
error.no_vehicle: These credentials are valid, but there is no Proton vehicle linked to this account.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Proton Link service. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Proton Link account is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the service. The car only uploads data periodically, so a shorter interval rarely yields newer values.
